Name: Larger-breasted Penny with improved hair (SFW)
Author: LambSteak
Description:
This is a SFW larger-breasted version of Penny. Compatible with SV 1.4.

My goal was to have a lore-friendly version which fits her reserved nature, just adding bigger boobs

I used AirplaneRandy's [i]Lewd Bacherolettes [/i]([url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/lewd-bachelorettes-portrait-mod-buxom-haley-added.108210/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/lewd-bachelorettes-portrait-mod-buxom-haley-added.108210/[/url]) and badboyzay's [i]Improved Penny Vanilla Portrait[/i] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1498]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1498[/url]) to make a larger-breasted Penny portrait with improved hair. Since Lewd Bacherolettes is out-dated, I had to make the cleavage of one of the portraits myself. All other cleavages by AirplaneRandy; all portrait hair by badboyzay.

I made the sprites myself. These are only minor tweaks to the original ones.

---

[i]Installation instructions:[/i]
[list]
[*]Find your game folder ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]click for instructions[/url]﻿)
[*]Download the mod (Large-breasted Penny with improved hair.rar)
[*]To mod the portrait:
[list]
[*]In your game folder, go to [code]Contents\Portraits[/code]
[*]Backup the file  [code]Penny.xnb[/code] (for example, rename it to [code]Penny (original).xnb[/code])
[*]Extract the file [code]﻿[/code][code]Penny.port.final.xnb[/code] to the Portraits folder and rename it to [code]Penny.xnb[/code]
[/list][*]To mod the sprites:
[list][*]In your game folder, go to [code]Contents\Characters[/code]
[*]Backup the file  [code]Penny.xnb[/code] (for example, rename it to [code]Penny (original).xnb[/code])
[*]Extract the file [code]﻿[/code][code]Penny.spr.final.xnb[/code] to the Characters folder and rename it to [code]Penny.xnb[/code]
[/list][/list]

If you want to revert to the original portrait or sprite, simply delete [code]Penny.xnb[/code] and replace it by your backup version (in [code]Portraits[/code] or [code]Characters[/code] accordingly).
